title: MultiFair: Multimodal Balanced Fairness-Aware Medical Classification with Dual-Level Gradient Modulation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring and comparing predictive performance and fairness metrics, specifically Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC), Equity-Scaled AUC (ES-AUC), Demographic Parity Difference (DPD), and Difference in Equalized Odds (DeOdds), across male and female patient demographic groups.
